hero.title: Architecture in Finland
hero.subtitle: Studying architecture in Finland offers students the opportunity to explore sustainable building design, urban planning, architectural technology and innovative approaches to the built environment. Finnish architecture education combines creative design, technical knowledge, environmental responsibility and practical studio projects. Students interested in Architecture in Finland can explore bachelor's programmes, English-taught master's degrees and related specialisations in sustainable architecture, urban design and building renovation.
